purpose: Normalize existing Market Pipeline outputs into governed evidence for Knowledge Alignment and the Decision Brain without modifying source modules or allowing upstream modules to make the final trade decision.
governance: Existing source modules are not overwritten.
Market State and MTF outputs are descriptive evidence, not final trade decisions.
Scenario decisions are normalized as candidate/context evidence only and cannot bypass Knowledge Alignment or the Contradiction Gate.
No BUY/SELL, entry, stop-loss, take-profit, or position size may be emitted by this adapter.
Murphy remains primary technical context when official book-rule outputs are connected.
Nison remains confirmation/contradiction only when official book-rule outputs are connected.
Trading in the Zone remains a process/psychology gate only when connected.
2025 remains OOS and cannot be used for tuning or calibration.
M15 must remain unavailable until real approved M15 data exists; it must not be fabricated from H1.
